  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "jenis_iuran_id" int4 NOT NULL,

)

CREATE TABLE "public"."pengurus_sub_organisasi" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "jabatan" text NOT NULL,
  "sub_organisasi_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deskripsi" text,

  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
